WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT major.department, COUNT(member.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM member
    JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
    GROUP BY major.department
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT department,
           member_count,
           1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
)
SELECT department,
       member_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM department_shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
